_comment: Source of truth: this JSON file. Regenerate the inline VALUES rows in
`python tools/generate_cve_sql.py`. The on-disk inline VALUES rows are
regenerated on every commit; edit only this file.
cvss:            Numeric CVSS v3 base score (Ponytail starter: only >= 7.0)
summary:         One-sentence description (matches the PGDG advisory text)
fixed_in:        Map: major version string -> first patched minor number.
Each entry produces one row per major in the SQL output.
Inclusions rule for any future scraper (layer 3): PG 15-18 only, CVSS >= 7.0.

cves.summary: Extension script @substitutions@ within quoting allows SQL injection
pg_dump integer overflow (32-bit builds) can execute arbitrary code at restore
Non-owner REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW CONCURRENTLY executes arbitrary SQL
pg_dump --restore uses an invalid type OID, allowing arbitrary SQL execution from a crafted dump
PL/Perl environment variable changes execute arbitrary code
Logical decoding can dlopen arbitrary file via choice of decoder plugin (REPLICATION privilege required)
Type confusion in cursor CLOSE + DECLARE executes arbitrary code via portal/cursor re-creation with different types
pg_dump heap buffer overflow executes arbitrary code
